usedFor: Zoho CRM holds leads, deals and accounts, and Google Docs gets notes through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deals” in Zoho CRM, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new deal adds its details to a doc tab, so the team shares one running record.

watchOut: “New Deals” in Zoho CRM is polling, so the doc updates after a scheduled check.
